rights_note: Facts only: function names, adoption percentages, category names/counts, workflow names, goals, durations, step titles and the third-party tool each step names. No workflow prompts, tips, course lessons or editorial text are stored. Courses are paid (Skill Leap) and were not opened.
workflow_anatomy: goal + role + time + difficulty + 3-6 steps; each step = title + one tool + a copy-ready structured prompt + a one-line rule of thumb. Creator playbooks add safety habits: consent before recording, test with non-sensitive/redacted data, review before sending, verify every claim, choose one reversible next action.

write.executor: Claude (native writing/reasoning; my-writing-style when drafting as the user)

research.executor: WebSearch/WebFetch + anthropic-skills:deep-research (cited sources); rank/monitoring data needs a connector

data.executor: python (pandas/duckdb) + charts (dataviz) + Sheets artifact or xlsx skill

slides.executor: Slides artifact type (or pptx skill when a .pptx is named)

design.executor: Design artifact / creative_paint.py / unified_draw.py; paid image generation (Higgsfield) only with explicit approval

docs.executor: Claude Docs (living doc) or Notion connector when the user asks for Notion

transcribe.executor: faster-whisper via montage_pro.py intake (consent of every participant first)

voice_avatar.executor: local TTS (Piper) or a connected voice/avatar service; consent + spend approval required

build.executor: Artifact (hosted page/app) or code in the repo; test with non-sensitive sample data

automate.executor: scheduled tasks (create_trigger/send_later) + local scripts; third-party automations through their connector

crm_comms.executor: connector via SearchMcpRegistry; Claude drafts, the user approves every send/post/update
crm_comms.ar: بريد وCRM وجدولة ونشر عبر موصّل

manual.executor: the user does this step (export, payment, real-world action)
